name: endturn-typed-menu
description: The folded end-of-turn menu (bot 2f09521: 'end turn or do another action' carries a plain End Turn, turnEnd, next to the usable end-of-turn abilities) is a typed turn.action decision: after Deepwrought (pbd28 r1) concludes a tactical action, the menu's End Turn is answered as turn.action {action: end_turn, abilities: false} and the turn passes on. Regression for the live 20:08-20:17 legacy 'End Turn' presses (shim engineOwnership freed the menu past the grace / mid-action).
